short_desc.en: A torrent client with a web interface.
short_desc.pt: Um cliente de torrent com interface web.

description.en: A lightweight BitTorrent client with a web interface, driven by Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr or used on its own; it can be put behind Gluetun's VPN
description.pt: Um cliente BitTorrent leve com interface web, comandado pelo Sonarr, Radarr e Lidarr ou usado sozinho; pode ficar atrás da VPN do Gluetun

hint.en: Where the library lives; every media app reads it.
hint.pt: Onde fica a biblioteca; todos os apps de mídia leem dela.
